lines: 这一章只回答一个问题：模型怎么变得更便宜。
This chapter asks one question: how do models get cheaper?
过去几年参数越堆越大，账单也跟着越堆越大。
Parameters kept growing, and so did the bill.
但大这个字，其实混了三种完全不同的成本。
But big mixes three very different kinds of cost.
它们分别卡在算力、延迟和显存上，解法完全不同。
Each is limited by compute, latency or memory, with different fixes.
这一章讲混合专家、注意力压缩和 FlashAttention。
We cover mixture of experts, attention compression and FlashAttention.
主线只有一条：把稠密计算换成结构化的稀疏。
One thread runs through it all: dense compute becomes structured sparsity.
先把成本拆成三份，不然优化会打错靶子。
Split the costs first, or you optimise the wrong thing.
训练成本是一次性的，卡在算力、数据和电力上。
Training is paid once, limited by compute, data and power.
推理成本每次调用都要付，卡在算力和延迟上。
Inference is paid on every call, limited by compute and latency.
显存成本训练和推理都要付，装参数、激活和缓存。
Memory is paid in both, holding weights, activations and caches.
第 7 章讲的是训练，这一章讲推理和显存。
Chapter 7 covered training; this chapter covers inference and memory.
因为模型变成产品后，推理成本会远远超过训练成本。
Once a model ships, inference cost far exceeds training cost.
模型训练一次，可能要被调用几十亿次。
Train once, then serve it billions of times.
先看参数花在哪：每个 block 里 FFN 占了大头。
Where do the weights go? Inside each block, the FFN takes most.
前馈网络的参数量，是四倍 d 平方的量级。
Its parameter count is on the order of four d squared.
混合专家的做法，是把它拆成 E 个小专家。
Mixture of experts splits it into E smaller experts.
每个 token 只走其中 k 个，其余完全不参与计算。
Each token visits only k of them; the rest never compute.
router 先给每个专家打分，再取分数最高的 top-k。
A router scores every expert, then keeps the top k.
输出是这几个专家的加权和，其余权重都是零。
The output is a weighted sum over those few; all other weights are zero.
于是总参数可以很大，但激活参数只有 top-k 个。
So total parameters can be huge while active parameters stay tiny.

scenes.en: BIG TO STORE, SMALL TO RUN
lines: 这不是纸上谈兵，两个模型能说明差距。
This is not theory; two models show the gap.
Switch Transformer 让每个 token 只走一个专家。
Switch Transformer sends each token to exactly one expert.
它把模型扩到一点六万亿参数，同算力下预训练快约七倍。
It reached 1.6 trillion parameters, training about 7x faster at equal compute.
DeepSeek-V3 总参数六千七百一十亿。
DeepSeek-V3 holds 671 billion parameters in total.
但每个 token 只激活三百七十亿，不到总量的百分之六。
Yet each token activates only 37 billion, under six percent.
它用十四点八万亿 token 训练，耗约二百七十八点八万 H800 小时。
It trained on 14.8 trillion tokens, using about 2.788 million H800 hours.
存的是大模型，算的是小模型，这就是稀疏激活的红利。
A big model stored, a small model computed: that is the payoff.
MoE 有一个工程难题，藏在 router 里。
MoE has an engineering problem hidden in the router.
如果 router 总把 token 送给同一个专家，其他专家就会饿死。
If the router always picks one expert, the others starve.
参数白存，模型容量浪费，这种失衡叫专家坍塌。
Stored weights go unused; this imbalance is expert collapse.
所以训练时要额外加一条负载均衡损失。
So training adds a load balancing loss.
它惩罚专家使用率过于不均，相当于给 router 一条 KPI。
It penalises uneven usage, like a KPI on the router.
你不仅要选对，还要让所有专家都有活干。
Pick well, but also keep every expert busy.
这和第 8 章的对齐一样，优化目标总要防止被极端化。
As with alignment in Chapter 8, an objective must not be pushed to extremes.
再看推理时最贵的一块内存：KV 缓存。
Now the most expensive memory in inference: the KV cache.
自回归生成时，每出一个新 token 都要看之前所有 token。
Autoregressive decoding looks back at every earlier token.
为了不重复计算，之前所有 Key 和 Value 会被存下来。
To avoid recomputing, all past Keys and Values are kept.
它的显存占用，正比于层数、头数、每头维度和序列长度。
Its size scales with layers, heads, head width and sequence length.
公式里还有一个因子二，因为 Key 和 Value 各存一份。
There is a factor of two, since Keys and Values are stored separately.
序列长度翻倍，KV 缓存就翻倍，批量大小也一样。
Double the sequence and the cache doubles, and so does the batch.
所以长上下文的主要成本不是计算，而是显存。
So long context costs memory, not mainly compute.
既然每个头都存一份 Key 和 Value 太贵，那就让它们共享。
If every head keeps its own Keys and Values, share them instead.
MQA 让所有头共用一组，缓存直接除以头数。
MQA shares one set across all heads, cutting the cache by the head count.
GQA 是折中，每 g 个头共用一组 Key 和 Value。
GQA sits in between: each group of g heads shares one set.
GQA 论文报告，升级已有模型只要原预训练算力的约百分之五。
The GQA paper reports about 5% of the original pretraining compute.
今天的开源模型，Llama、Mistral、Qwen 大多用 GQA。
Today's open models, Llama, Mistral and Qwen, mostly use GQA.
MLA 走另一条路，把 Key 和 Value 投影成低维潜在向量。
MLA takes another route, projecting Keys and Values into a low-rank latent.
DeepSeek-V2 报告缓存减少百分之九十三点三，吞吐提升五点七六倍。
DeepSeek-V2 reports 93.3% less KV cache and 5.76x throughput.
FlashAttention 解决的是另一个瓶颈：搬数据。
FlashAttention attacks a different bottleneck: moving data.
GPU 算一个数很快，把数从显存搬到芯片上却很慢。
A GPU computes fast but moves numbers from memory slowly.
算力增长远快于显存带宽，这个差距叫内存墙。
Compute outgrew memory bandwidth; the gap is the memory wall.
标准注意力要把 n 乘 n 的分数矩阵写回显存，再读出来。
Standard attention writes the n by n score matrix to memory, then rereads it.
序列一长，这些来回搬运比计算本身还贵。
On long sequences, that traffic costs more than the maths.
它把 Q、K、V 切成小块，在高速缓存里用分块和在线 softmax 算完。
It tiles Q, K and V, finishing each tile on chip with online softmax.
整个过程不把中间大矩阵写回显存，所以它是精确的。
The big intermediate never returns to memory, and the result stays exact.
BERT-large 端到端快约一成半，GPT-2 上约三倍，长序列更明显。
About 15% faster end to end on BERT-large, about 3x on GPT-2, more on long sequences.
注意力像全程录音，任何时刻都能回放任意片段。
Attention is a full recording: replay any moment, any time.
代价是存储随长度增长，计算量随长度平方增长。
The price: storage grows with length, compute with its square.
状态空间模型像边听边记笔记，只保留摘要。
A state space model takes notes instead, keeping only a summary.
它维护一个固定大小的状态，每读一个 token 就更新一次。
It holds one fixed-size state and updates it per token.
复杂度是线性的，存储恒定，但细节会丢。
Linear time, constant memory, at the cost of detail.
Mamba 让 A、B、C 依赖输入，模型学会选择性记忆。
Mamba makes A, B and C input-dependent, so memory becomes selective.
论文报告吞吐约为同规模的五倍，3B 可匹敌两倍大小。
The paper reports about 5x throughput, matching a model twice its size.
所以前沿是混合架构：多数层压缩，少数层做精确检索。
So the frontier is hybrid: most layers compress, a few retrieve exactly.
不改架构也能省，先看微调这一步有多贵。
You can also save without changing the architecture: look at fine-tuning.
微调七百亿参数的模型，要更新全部参数，显存吃不消。
Fine-tuning 70 billion parameters means updating all of them; memory cannot cope.
LoRA 冻结原权重，只学一个低秩增量。
LoRA freezes the original weights and learns only a low-rank delta.
增量写成两个小矩阵的乘积，秩 r 远小于维度 d。
The delta is a product of two small matrices, with rank r far below d.
可训练参数减少约一万倍，显存减少约三倍。
Trainable parameters drop about 10,000x, memory about 3x.
效果接近全量微调，因为它假设任务带来的改变是低秩的。
Quality nears full fine-tuning, assuming the task's change is low-rank.
这个假设是否成立，是 LoRA 有效性的核心争议点。
Whether that assumption holds is the core dispute over LoRA.
另一条路更直接：把每个数存得更小一点。
Another route is blunter: store every number smaller.
把 FP16 的权重压成 INT8、INT4，甚至 FP8。
Squeeze FP16 weights into INT8, INT4 or even FP8.
DeepSeek-V3 的一个工程亮点，是用 FP8 做训练，不只是推理。
A highlight of DeepSeek-V3 is FP8 in training, not just inference.
代价是精度损失，但神经网络对噪声有天然的鲁棒性。
The cost is precision, yet networks are naturally robust to noise.
就像 Dropout，适度的量化几乎不影响效果。
Like Dropout, moderate quantisation barely changes results.
但够用的标准取决于下游任务，量化后必须重新评测。
Good enough depends on the task, so re-evaluate after quantising.
把这一章的技术排在一起，方向其实只有一条。
Line up this chapter's techniques and one direction appears.
参数从全部激活，变成只激活 top-k 专家。
Parameters go from all active to top-k active.
注意力从每个头独立，变成共享或压缩。
Attention goes from per-head storage to sharing or compression.
计算顺序从大矩阵往返显存，变成本地分块。
Compute goes from memory round-trips to on-chip tiles.
共同的数学主题，是用结构化的稀疏性逼近稠密计算。
The shared theme: structured sparsity approximating dense compute.
但稀疏不是免费午餐，每一种省法都标好了价码。
But sparsity is not free; every saving has a price tag.
路由会失衡，共享有失真，状态会忘事，量化会掉精度。
Routing can collapse, sharing distorts, state forgets, quantisation loses precision.
这一章的主线，是从稠密计算走向稀疏。
The thread of this chapter: from dense to sparse.
MoE 省计算，GQA 和 MLA 省缓存，分块省搬运。
MoE saves compute, GQA and MLA save cache, FlashAttention saves traffic.
Mamba 省掉回看，LoRA 和量化省掉显存。
Mamba drops look-back; LoRA and quantisation drop memory.
每一种省法都标好了价码，稀疏不是免费午餐。
Every saving carries a price; sparsity is not free.
下一章讲怎么让模型查资料：RAG 与长上下文。
Next: how models look things up, RAG and long context.
